allowed_edges.rationale: The frontend calls only the documented FastAPI HTTP surface.
The frontend consumes stable inspection and error DTO semantics.
Inspection and stream routes invoke the public detection service through one application-owned lock.
API routes persist, query, delete, and export inspection records through the history service.
FastAPI validates and serializes the shared DTOs.
Detection emits normalized defects independent of model-library objects.
Persistence stores and returns shared inspection semantics.
Executable checks verify the public frontend build and behavior.
Integration tests and loopback HTTP evidence verify the public inspection and history API.
Runtime evidence verifies model integrity, preprocessing, service inference, scoring, and annotation outputs.
Unit and loopback HTTP evidence verify history persistence, media consistency, and the CSV projection.

forbidden_edges.reason: The browser must use the backend API and never run or import server detection code.
The browser must not access backend persistence directly.
The backend must remain independent of React implementation.
Detection is a lower-level service and must not import HTTP routes.
Detection returns results and does not persist records.
Persistence is a lower-level service and must not import HTTP routes.
History never loads or executes a model.
Shared contracts must remain independent of application code.
Shared contracts must remain independent of API implementation.
